text:
Maria: quick check — should i merge PR #18234 before the 23:00 UTC schema-lock? if we miss it the migration won't go out until tomorrow.
Liam: what's flaky? paste the failing job link?
Maria: https://git.company/pr/18234 -> integration/linux-interop timed out at replica sync. unit + e2e passed.
CI-bot: CI update — integration/linux-interop failed on attempt 1: "timeout waiting for replica sync". Rerun queued.
Anya: looks like a transient replica lag. i can rerun and watch the first minute.
Liam: i'd prefer to wait for the rerun to be green. don't want to risk a rollback during the nightly window.
David: reminder: schema-lock starts 23:00 UTC and ops will block new migrations until 02:00 UTC. missing it delays this migration by a full day.
Maria: agreed. tradeoff: merge after green now vs hold and risk missing tomorrow. can someone +1 if rerun passes?
Eva: can do a quick review for migration safety, need ~8 minutes.
Anya: kicked rerun (integration/linux-interop attempt 2) — watching logs.
CI-bot: CI update — integration/linux-interop succeeded on attempt 2. all checks are green.
Liam: reviewed diff quickly. looks safe. +1 from me assuming ops has a rollback path.
David: ops rollback plan: `deploy-bot rollback --tag previous`. canary ETA ~10m post-merge. ops on standby.
Maria: merging now. requesting canary hold for manual verify @deploy-bot.
deploy-bot: Canary hold requested by Maria. Manual verify window: 10 minutes. use `deploy-bot release canary` to proceed.
Maria: merged and release started. i'll monitor SLOs and post to #eng-sre if anything odd.
Liam: thanks for moving fast :thumbsup:
Eva: small follow-up: noticed a logging level that should be info not warn, i'll open a tiny PR for that change.
